title: Insertion Sort
definition: Insertion Sort builds the sorted part of the array one element at a time.
realLifeExample: It is like picking one playing card at a time and inserting it into the correct place in your hand.

algorithm.Iterative:
1. Start from the second element.
2. Store the current key.
3. Shift larger elements one place right.
4. Insert the key into the gap.
5. Repeat until the array is sorted.
algorithm.Functions:
1. Use a helper function to insert one element into the sorted prefix.
2. Call it for each new position.
3. Return the sorted array.
algorithm.Recursion:
1. Recursively sort the first n - 1 elements.
2. Insert the nth element into the sorted part.
3. Return when the base case is reached.
